senses.gloss:
क्षीरसागर

KṢĪRASĀGARA . Sea of Milk. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Udyoga Parva, Chapter 102, that brahmā drank too much of Amṛta and vomited. From the vomit the cow surabhi came into being. The milk of surabhi flowed and collected into a sea. This sea is called the milk-sea or kṣīrasāgara.

क्षीरवती

KṢĪRAVATĪ . A holy bath. Those who bathe in this holy bath will obtain the fruits of performing the sacrifice of vājapeya. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 84).

क्षीरिन्

KṢĪRIN . A tree in the family of the uttara Kurus. This tree has six tastes. Milk flows ceaselessly from this tree. It is said that from the fruit of this tree we could get cloth, ornaments etc. (M.B. bhīṣma parva, Chapter 7).

क्षितिकम्पन

KṢITIKAMPANA . A captain of the army of skanda. (M.B. śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Stanza 59).
